name: walk_phone_call
text: A person walks steadily forward while holding a mobile phone firmly against the right ear with the right hand, right elbow bent and raised. The left arm swings naturally. The phone hand stays beside the ear throughout.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右手持续举在耳边，左臂自然摆动；循环取试片59至93帧的步态，生成后保留中间完整周期。手持手机实体未烘焙。
